infinite_slope_fos — Infinite-slope (planar translational) factor of safety in closed form (Duncan-Wright): FOS = [c' + (gamma*z*cos^2(beta) - u)*tan(phi')] / (gamma*z*sin(beta)cos(beta)). For the shallow surface-parallel failure mechanism; the depth cancels for cohesionless soil (FOS = tan(phi')/tan(beta) dry, or gamma'/gamma that for seepage at the surface). Use analyze_slope/search_critical_surface for circular/noncircular mechanisms.

ParameterTypeDescription
slope_anglefloatrequiredSlope inclination beta (degrees from horizontal), 0-90.
phifloatrequiredEffective friction angle (degrees).
gammafloatrequiredTotal (moist/saturated) unit weight (kN/m3).
cfloatoptionalEffective cohesion (kPa). Default 0 (cohesionless). default: 0.0
depthfloatoptionalSlip-plane depth z below the surface (m). Cancels for c'=0; matters when c'>0. default: 1.0
water_conditionstroptional'dry' (u=0); 'seepage_parallel' (steady seepage parallel to the slope, phreatic surface at depth water_depth, u=gamma_w*(z-water_depth)*cos^2 beta); 'ru' (u=ru*gamma*z). allowed: dry, seepage_parallel, ru default: "dry"
gamma_wfloatoptionalUnit weight of water (kN/m3), for seepage_parallel. default: 9.81
rufloatoptionalPore-pressure ratio, for water_condition='ru'. default: 0.0
water_depthfloatoptionalDepth of the phreatic surface below the ground (m), for seepage_parallel. 0 = water table at the surface. default: 0.0

rapid_drawdown_fos — Rapid-drawdown FOS on a SPECIFIED slip surface: USACE/Army-Corps 2-stage, Lowe-Karafiath 2-stage, or Duncan-Wright-Wong 3-stage. Low-permeability layers respond undrained after fast reservoir drawdown; give them the total-stress R-envelope (soil_layers[].R_c, R_phi) alongside c_prime/phi (R_phi=null => free-draining). Stage 1 = full-pool effective stresses; stage 2 = undrained strength from the R and effective envelopes (Kc-interpolated for Lowe-Karafiath and 3-stage); stage 3 (3-stage only) substitutes the drained strength where lower; final FOS is solved at the drawn-down pool.

tension_crack_water_depthfloatoptionalWater depth in the tension crack (m). default: 0.0
tension_crack_sidestroptionalWhich crest end the tension crack is on: 'entry' (default, low-x / slip-surface entry) or 'exit' (high-x). Put it on whichever side the crest is on; no need to mirror the slope. allowed: entry, exit default: "entry"
tension_crack_modelstroptionalTension-crack mechanism: 'strength' (default) keeps the cracked wedge as zero-shear-strength driving soil; 'truncation' removes it from the sliding mass (mass ends at the vertical crack face, as Slide2/UTEXAS do). Truncation is less conservative. allowed: strength, truncation default: "strength"
reverse_curvaturestroptionalA circle whose centre is below the ground where it comes out would turn back above its centre (Slide2: reverse curvature). 'tension_crack' (default, as Slide2) closes it with a dry vertical crack; 'discard' drops such circles from searches. allowed: tension_crack, discard default: "tension_crack"
pore_pressure_pointsarrayoptionalDiscrete pore-pressure field as [[x, z, u], ...] triples (u in kPa) -- a flow-net / TIN sampling. When given, the base pore pressure at each slice is interpolated from this field (linear on the Delaunay triangulation, nearest-node fallback outside the hull, suction clamped to 0), OVERRIDING the gwt_points piezometric line and per-layer ru. The ponded-water buttress still comes from gwt_points, so set BOTH for a reservoir over a flow-net field.
nailsarrayoptionalSoil nails (per metre of slope run): [{x_head, z_head, length required; inclination deg below horizontal=15, bar_diameter mm=25, drill_hole_diameter mm=150, fy MPa=420, bond_stress kPa=100, spacing_h m=1.5, support_convention}]. Capacity = min(pullout behind slip surface, bar tensile)/spacing_h (FHWA GEC-7).
anchorsarrayoptionalTieback anchors: [{x_head, z_head, length, T_allow kN/m required; inclination=15, support_convention}]. Full T_allow applied when the bond zone crosses the slip surface.
geosyntheticsarrayoptionalHorizontal geosynthetic layers: [{elevation, T_allow kN/m required; x_start, x_end, support_convention optional}]. Every support (nails, anchors, geosynthetics, piles) acts at the base of the slice it crosses (Wright & Duncan 1991). support_convention: 'active' (default; Duncan & Wright Method A / Slide2 Active: the force is not divided by F and reduces the driving side -- give the ALLOWABLE force) or 'passive' (Method B / Slide2 Passive: divided by F with the soil strength -- give the ULTIMATE force; lower FOS for the same force). All methods.
stabilizing_pilesarrayoptionalSingle-row stabilizing/micro piles crossing the slope (Ito & Matsui 1975 or a specified shear): [{x required; spacing m=1.0 (D1); z_head, z_toe optional}]. Set the resistance EITHER by shear_capacity (kN per pile; per-metre force = shear_capacity/spacing) OR ito_matsui=true with diameter (m; D2=spacing-diameter) and optional c/phi/gamma (default: soil layer) giving the Ito-Matsui plastic lateral force integrated from head to slip surface. force_direction 'horizontal' (default) or 'normal'. support_convention 'active' (default) or 'passive' as for geosynthetics. Stabilizing force at the slip crossing.
reinforcement_forcefloatoptionalSingle equivalent horizontal reinforcement force (kN/m). Simpler alternative to nails/anchors. default: 0.0
reinforcement_elevationfloatoptionalElevation of the equivalent reinforcement force (m).
xcfloatoptionalCircle center x (m). Required for circular.
ycfloatoptionalCircle center y (m). Required for circular.
radiusfloatoptionalCircle radius (m). Required for circular.
slip_pointsarrayoptionalPolyline slip surface [[x,y],...] for noncircular. Use instead of xc/yc/radius.
drawdown_from_elevationfloatrequiredReservoir surface elevation BEFORE drawdown (m).
drawdown_to_elevationfloatrequiredReservoir surface elevation AFTER drawdown (m); must be below drawdown_from_elevation.
methodstroptional'duncan_3stage' (Duncan-Wright-Wong, Kc-interpolated undrained strength + stage-3 drained substitution), 'lowe_karafiath' (the SAME Kc-interpolated stage-2 strength but NO stage 3, so >= duncan_3stage), or 'corps_2stage' (USACE combined min(R, effective) envelope, no stage 3). allowed: corps_2stage, duncan_3stage, lowe_karafiath default: "duncan_3stage"
f_interslicestroptionalGLE interslice function ('constant' = Spencer). allowed: constant, half_sine, clipped_sine, trapezoidal default: "constant"
n_slicesintoptionalNumber of slices. default: 50
stage1_phreatic_pointsarrayoptionalOptional steady-seepage phreatic surface [[x,z],...] for the STAGE-1 consolidation stresses only. Default (omitted) uses a flat full-pool phreatic (hydrostatic to the reservoir) -- the conservative no-through-seepage bound. Supply the flow-net/Casagrande phreatic line (declining from the pool level at the upstream face through the dam) to reproduce the steady-seepage condition Slide2/EM 1110-2-1902 use, which raises the mobilized undrained strengths and the FOS.
stage3_effective_normalstroptional3-stage only: basis for the STAGE-3 drained-substitution effective normal stress. 'fellenius' (default) uses the W*cos(a)/l - u estimate (historical); 'gle' uses the rigorous GLE drawn-down normal (consistent with stage 1), which removes spurious drained substitutions and raises the FOS toward the published Duncan-Wright-Wong value (e.g. Slide2 #96: 1.27 -> 1.37). Inert for the 2-stage method. allowed: fellenius, gle default: "fellenius"
tolfloatoptionalConvergence tolerance for the iterative methods. default: 0.0001

search_rapid_drawdown — SEARCH for the critical (minimum-FOS) slip surface under RAPID-DRAWDOWN strengths (Corps 2-stage / Lowe-Karafiath 2-stage / Duncan-Wright-Wong 3-stage). Like search_critical_surface but the per-trial FOS is the rapid-drawdown solve; supports circular and noncircular searches. Use this (not rapid_drawdown_fos) when you do NOT already have a specific trial surface. Low-permeability layers need the R-envelope (soil_layers[].R_c, R_phi).

ParameterTypeDescription
surface_pointsarrayrequiredGround surface as [[x,y], ...] array (x increasing).
soil_layersarrayrequiredArray of soil-layer dicts: {top_elevation, bottom_elevation, gamma (all required); name, gamma_sat, phi, c_prime, cu, analysis_mode ('drained'|'undrained'), ru optional; bottom_boundary_points and top_boundary_points ([[x,z],...], sorted by x) optional, a sloping bottom or top in place of the flat elevation}. Per-layer strength_model: 'mohr_coulomb' (default), 'shansep' (su = shansep_S ocr^shansep_m sigma'_v; fields shansep_S, shansep_m, ocr, su_min) 'hoek_brown' (Generalized Hoek-Brown; fields hb_sigci kPa, hb_gsi, hb_mi, hb_D) or 'anisotropic' (undrained su varies with the slice-base inclination alpha; fields su_active [kPa, ACTIVE/crest zone, alpha>=+45deg], su_dss [direct simple shear, alpha=0], su_passive [PASSIVE/toe zone, alpha<=-45deg] — su_active>=su_dss>=su_passive for K>1 clays; Casagrande-Carrillo sin(2alpha) interpolation; standard toe-at-low-x slope). For rapid_drawdown_fos, low-permeability layers also take the total-stress R-envelope R_c (kPa) and R_phi (deg); R_phi omitted/null => free-draining. One material per point: where two layers cover the same ground the one listed FIRST holds it, for weight and strength (reported in layer_overlaps); ground above the deepest layer's bottom that no layer covers is refused.
gwt_pointsarrayoptionalGroundwater table [[x,y],...]. If above the ground surface, ponded water is auto-detected (water weight + horizontal hydrostatic thrust applied as external loads).
khfloatoptionalHorizontal pseudo-static seismic coefficient (acts on soil weight only). default: 0.0
surchargefloatoptionalVertical surcharge (kPa). A single loaded zone; use 'surcharges' for several distinct loaded areas. default: 0.0
surcharge_x_rangearrayoptional[x_start, x_end] extent of the single 'surcharge'.
surchargesarrayoptionalSeveral distinct surcharge zones (bench + crest loads, etc.): [{pressure kPa, x_start, x_end}, ...]. Each zone's pressure is summed at any x it covers, ON TOP OF the single 'surcharge'/'surcharge_x_range'. Represent a linearly-varying (trapezoidal) load as its mean uniform pressure or as several thin zones.
tension_crack_depthfloatoptionalTension crack depth at the crest (m). default: 0.0
tension_crack_water_depthfloatoptionalWater depth in the tension crack (m). default: 0.0

anchorsarrayoptionalTieback anchors: [{x_head, z_head, length, T_allow kN/m required; inclination=15, support_convention}]. Full T_allow applied when the bond zone crosses the slip surface.

All methods.
stabilizing_pilesarrayoptionalSingle-row stabilizing/micro piles crossing the slope (Ito & Matsui 1975 or a specified shear): [{x required; spacing m=1.0 (D1); z_head, z_toe optional}]. Set the resistance EITHER by shear_capacity (kN per pile; per-metre force = shear_capacity/spacing) OR ito_matsui=true with diameter (m; D2=spacing-diameter) and optional c/phi/gamma (default: soil layer) giving the Ito-Matsui plastic lateral force integrated from head to slip surface. force_direction 'horizontal' (default) or 'normal'. support_convention 'active' (default) or 'passive' as for geosynthetics. Stabilizing force at the slip crossing.
reinforcement_forcefloatoptionalSingle equivalent horizontal reinforcement force (kN/m). Simpler alternative to nails/anchors. default: 0.0
reinforcement_elevationfloatoptionalElevation of the equivalent reinforcement force (m).
drawdown_from_elevationfloatrequiredReservoir surface elevation BEFORE drawdown (m).
drawdown_to_elevationfloatrequiredReservoir surface elevation AFTER drawdown (m); must be below drawdown_from_elevation.
methodstroptionalRapid-drawdown stage method: 'corps_2stage' (default), 'lowe_karafiath', or 'duncan_3stage'. See rapid_drawdown_fos. allowed: corps_2stage, duncan_3stage, lowe_karafiath default: "corps_2stage"
surface_typestroptionalSearch strategy: 'circular' (centre grid), 'entry_exit' (arcs between entry/exit windows), 'noncircular' (random polylines), 'noncircular_de' (differential-evolution refinement). allowed: circular, entry_exit, noncircular, noncircular_de default: "circular"
x_rangearrayoptional[xmin, xmax] for the circle-centre grid (circular).
y_rangearrayoptional[ymin, ymax] for the circle-centre grid (circular).
x_entry_rangearrayoptional[xmin, xmax] window for the slip surface's ENTRY: its low-x end, whichever way the slope faces (the toe side of a slope rising to the right, the crest side of one falling to the right).
x_exit_rangearrayoptional[xmin, xmax] window for the slip surface's EXIT: its high-x end. Windows given the other way round (entry wholly right of exit) are swapped, and the result's warnings say so.
nxintoptionalGrid divisions in x (or entry divisions for entry_exit). Each trial is several LE solves -- keep modest. default: 10
nyintoptionalGrid divisions in y (or exit divisions for entry_exit). default: 10
n_trialsintoptionalRandom trials for noncircular searches. default: 500
n_pointsintoptionalPolyline vertices for noncircular searches. default: 5
n_slicesintoptionalNumber of slices per trial. default: 50
seedintoptionalRandom seed for reproducible noncircular searches.
f_interslicestroptionalGLE interslice function ('constant' = Spencer). allowed: constant, half_sine, clipped_sine, trapezoidal default: "constant"
stage1_phreatic_pointsarrayoptionalOptional steady-seepage stage-1 phreatic surface [[x,z],...] (see rapid_drawdown_fos).
stage3_effective_normalstroptional3-stage stage-3 drained-substitution normal basis: 'fellenius' (default) or 'gle' (rigorous). See rapid_drawdown_fos. allowed: fellenius, gle default: "fellenius"
time_budget_sfloatoptionalTime budget of the whole search in seconds (at most 600), as search_critical_surface: each trial is two or three GLE solves, so the main search scores coarse first and stops at 80 % of the budget, and search.warnings and search.search_ranges.time_budget say what was covered. default: 180.0
tolfloatoptionalConvergence tolerance for the iterative methods. default: 0.0001

newmark_displacement — Newmark rigid-block permanent DOWNSLOPE displacement by double integration of an earthquake acceleration time history against the yield coefficient ky (no upslope rebound). polarity='downslope' (default) is the standard Newmark/Jibson single-block convention (only the destabilizing polarity drives the block); 'rectified' uses the absolute record so both polarities drive it (conservative, ~2x for a symmetric record). Get ky from yield_acceleration. For a quick estimate without a record, use newmark_jibson2007.

ParameterTypeDescription
kyfloatrequiredYield seismic coefficient (fraction of g); ay = ky*g.
accelarrayrequiredGround acceleration time history (equally spaced), in m/s^2 (or in g if accel_in_g=true). Sign convention is downslope-positive when polarity='downslope'.
dtfloatrequiredTime step of the record (s).
accel_in_gbooloptionalTrue if 'accel' is in units of g rather than m/s^2. default: false
polaritystroptional'downslope' (default; standard Newmark/Jibson — integrate only destabilizing-polarity exceedances of the signed record) or 'rectified' (integrate the absolute record so both polarities drive the block; conservative, orientation-independent). allowed: downslope, rectified default: "downslope"

newmark_jibson2007 — Jibson (2007) regression estimate of Newmark displacement from the critical-acceleration ratio ky/amax (Eq. 6): log10 D[cm] = 0.215 + log10[(1-ky/amax)^2.341 (ky/amax)^-1.438], sigma=0.51 log10. Needs no time history; requires 0 < ky < amax.

ParameterTypeDescription
kyfloatrequiredYield / critical seismic coefficient (fraction of g).
amaxfloatrequiredPeak ground acceleration (fraction of g). Must exceed ky.

bray_travasarou_2007 — Bray & Travasarou (2007) simplified seismic DEVIATORIC slope displacement — a fully-coupled stick-slip sliding-block regression that captures sliding-mass flexibility (via the fundamental period Ts) and spectral demand at 1.5*Ts, which the rigid-block Jibson/integration models don't. Returns P(D=0) (prob. of negligible <=1 cm displacement) and the median non-zero displacement (16/84% via sigma_ln=0.66). A period-dependent cross-check for Jibson.

ParameterTypeDescription
kyfloatrequiredYield / critical seismic coefficient (fraction of g).
tsfloatrequiredInitial fundamental period of the potential sliding mass (s); ~4H/Vs (deep/wide) or 2.6H/Vs (surface). Ts<0.05 s auto-uses the rigid-block branch (then sa_1p5ts is the PGA).
sa_1p5tsfloatrequired5%-damped elastic spectral acceleration at the degraded period 1.5*Ts (g).
magnitudefloatrequiredMoment magnitude Mw.
rigidbooloptionalForce the rigid (True) / flexible (False) branch; default auto-selects rigid when ts<0.05 s.

Capacity = min(pullout behind slip surface, bar tensile)/spacing_h (FHWA GEC-7).
anchorsarrayoptionalTieback anchors: [{x_head, z_head, length, T_allow kN/m required; inclination=15, support_convention}]. Full T_allow applied when the bond zone crosses the slip surface.
geosyntheticsarrayoptionalHorizontal geosynthetic layers: [{elevation, T_allow kN/m required; x_start, x_end, support_convention optional}]. Every support (nails, anchors, geosynthetics, piles) acts at the base of the slice it crosses (Wright & Duncan 1991). support_convention: 'active' (default; Duncan & Wright Method A / Slide2 Active: the force is not divided by F and reduces the driving side -- give the ALLOWABLE force) or 'passive' (Method B / Slide2 Passive: divided by F with the soil strength -- give the ULTIMATE force; lower FOS for the same force). All methods.
stabilizing_pilesarrayoptionalSingle-row stabilizing/micro piles crossing the slope (Ito & Matsui 1975 or a specified shear): [{x required; spacing m=1.0 (D1); z_head, z_toe optional}]. Set the resistance EITHER by shear_capacity (kN per pile; per-metre force = shear_capacity/spacing) OR ito_matsui=true with diameter (m; D2=spacing-diameter) and optional c/phi/gamma (default: soil layer) giving the Ito-Matsui plastic lateral force integrated from head to slip surface. force_direction 'horizontal' (default) or 'normal'. support_convention 'active' (default) or 'passive' as for geosynthetics. Stabilizing force at the slip crossing.
reinforcement_forcefloatoptionalSingle equivalent horizontal reinforcement force (kN/m). Simpler alternative to nails/anchors. default: 0.0
reinforcement_elevationfloatoptionalElevation of the equivalent reinforcement force (m).
surface_typestroptionalSearch strategy. 'entry_exit' grids circular arcs between entry/exit windows; 'noncircular_de' refines random polylines with scipy differential evolution. allowed: circular, entry_exit, noncircular, noncircular_de, pso, weak_layer default: "circular"
methodstroptionalLimit-equilibrium method (noncircular searches use spencer when 'bishop' is requested). Cost per trial surface, measured on four pinned slopes: fellenius about the same as bishop, janbu about twice bishop, and spencer, morgenstern_price and gle each about 30 to 40 times bishop at 30 slices and 40 to 70 times at 60 slices. A whole search costs less than that ratio where it scans with Bishop (the centre grid's refinement, the toe circles): the default 10 x 10 centre grid took 2-3 s with bishop and 14-16 s with spencer, a 10 x 10 or 12 x 12 entry_exit grid 2 s and 60-70 s, a 30 x 30 entry_exit grid at 60 slices 21 s and 972 s; the noncircular searches, scored with Spencer at their defaults (500 trials, 5 points), took 6-7 s (noncircular), 3-7 s (weak_layer) and 10-12 s (noncircular_de), 41 s where differential evolution scored 2,325 surfaces (development laptop; the app's host up to twice as long). On the circles of these slopes bishop and spencer gave FOS within 0.3 % of each other. Which method to use is the engineer's call; bishop_screen keeps the method and scans with Bishop. allowed: fellenius, bishop, janbu, spencer, morgenstern_price, gle default: "bishop"
x_rangearrayoptional[xmin, xmax] for circle center search.
y_rangearrayoptional[ymin, ymax] for circle center search.
x_entry_rangearrayoptional[xmin, xmax] window for the slip surface's ENTRY: its low-x end, whichever way the slope faces (the toe side of a slope rising to the right, the crest side of one falling to the right).
x_exit_rangearrayoptional[xmin, xmax] window for the slip surface's EXIT: its high-x end. Windows given the other way round (entry wholly right of exit) are swapped, and the result's warnings say so.
nxintoptionalGrid divisions in x (or entry divisions for entry_exit). default: 10
nyintoptionalGrid divisions in y (or exit divisions for entry_exit). default: 10
n_trialsintoptionalRandom trials for noncircular searches. default: 500
n_pointsintoptionalPolyline vertices for noncircular searches. default: 5
n_slicesintoptionalNumber of slices per trial. default: 30
seedintoptionalRandom seed for reproducible noncircular/PSO/DE searches.
time_budget_sfloatoptionalTime budget of the whole search in seconds (at most 600). The main search scores its centres or entry/exit pairs coarse first and stops at 80 % of the budget; the result is then the lowest surface found, and warnings and search_ranges.time_budget say what was scored of how many, at what spacing, the run time projected for the whole search, and what was not run. Raise it for a long search you mean to wait for. default: 180.0
bishop_screenbooloptionalcircular and entry_exit searches with spencer / morgenstern_price / gle: score every centre or pair with Bishop's simplified method, then re-score the lowest (at least 10, every one within 5 % of the lowest, at most 30) with the method itself; the reported FOS is the method's own. On four pinned slopes it found the same surfaces and FOS as the unscreened search in 35-60 % of the time on the default centre grid, 15-30 % on 10 x 10 and 12 x 12 entry_exit grids and 3 % on a 30 x 30 entry_exit grid at 60 slices (33 s against 972 s). Not applied where supports are modelled; noncircular searches are not screened. default: false
m_alpha_rulestroptionalWhich slices the m_alpha < 0.2 check looks at (every search leaves out a surface that fails it, as Slide2 does with its 'Check malpha < 0.2' setting on). 'frictional': slices with phi' > 0; on a phi' = 0 slice m_alpha = cos(a) does not change the FOS, so leaving such a surface out only raises the minimum. 'every_slice': every slice, as Slide2 checks. allowed: frictional, every_slice default: "frictional"
tolfloatoptionalConvergence tolerance for the iterative methods. default: 0.0001

fosm_fos — FOSM / Taylor-series reliability of the FOS on a fixed slip surface (Duncan 2000): central finite differences at +/- 1 sigma per variable -> COV_F, beta (normal + lognormal), probability of failure, per-variable variance contributions. Supports both independent per-layer scalar variables AND a correlated depth-varying su-gradient law (see 'variables').

ParameterTypeDescription
surface_pointsarrayrequiredGround surface as [[x,y], ...] array (x increasing).
soil_layersarrayrequiredArray of soil-layer dicts: {top_elevation, bottom_elevation, gamma (all required); name, gamma_sat, phi, c_prime, cu, analysis_mode ('drained'|'undrained'), ru optional; bottom_boundary_points and top_boundary_points ([[x,z],...], sorted by x) optional, a sloping bottom or top in place of the flat elevation}. Per-layer strength_model: 'mohr_coulomb' (default), 'shansep' (su = shansep_S ocr^shansep_m sigma'_v; fields shansep_S, shansep_m, ocr, su_min) 'hoek_brown' (Generalized Hoek-Brown; fields hb_sigci kPa, hb_gsi, hb_mi, hb_D) or 'anisotropic' (undrained su varies with the slice-base inclination alpha; fields su_active [kPa, ACTIVE/crest zone, alpha>=+45deg], su_dss [direct simple shear, alpha=0], su_passive [PASSIVE/toe zone, alpha<=-45deg] — su_active>=su_dss>=su_passive for K>1 clays; Casagrande-Carrillo sin(2alpha) interpolation; standard toe-at-low-x slope). For rapid_drawdown_fos, low-permeability layers also take the total-stress R-envelope R_c (kPa) and R_phi (deg); R_phi omitted/null => free-draining. One material per point: where two layers cover the same ground the one listed FIRST holds it, for weight and strength (reported in layer_overlaps); ground above the deepest layer's bottom that no layer covers is refused.
gwt_pointsarrayoptionalGroundwater table [[x,y],...]. If above the ground surface, ponded water is auto-detected (water weight + horizontal hydrostatic thrust applied as external loads).
khfloatoptionalHorizontal pseudo-static seismic coefficient (acts on soil weight only). default: 0.0
surchargefloatoptionalVertical surcharge (kPa). A single loaded zone; use 'surcharges' for several distinct loaded areas. default: 0.0
surcharge_x_rangearrayoptional[x_start, x_end] extent of the single 'surcharge'.
surchargesarrayoptionalSeveral distinct surcharge zones (bench + crest loads, etc.): [{pressure kPa, x_start, x_end}, ...]. Each zone's pressure is summed at any x it covers, ON TOP OF the single 'surcharge'/'surcharge_x_range'. Represent a linearly-varying (trapezoidal) load as its mean uniform pressure or as several thin zones.
tension_crack_depthfloatoptionalTension crack depth at the crest (m). default: 0.0
tension_crack_water_depthfloatoptionalWater depth in the tension crack (m). default: 0.0
tension_crack_sidestroptionalWhich crest end the tension crack is on: 'entry' (default, low-x / slip-surface entry) or 'exit' (high-x). Put it on whichever side the crest is on; no need to mirror the slope. allowed: entry, exit default: "entry"
tension_crack_modelstroptionalTension-crack mechanism: 'strength' (default) keeps the cracked wedge as zero-shear-strength driving soil; 'truncation' removes it from the sliding mass (mass ends at the vertical crack face, as Slide2/UTEXAS do). Truncation is less conservative. allowed: strength, truncation default: "strength"
reverse_curvaturestroptionalA circle whose centre is below the ground where it comes out would turn back above its centre (Slide2: reverse curvature). 'tension_crack' (default, as Slide2) closes it with a dry vertical crack; 'discard' drops such circles from searches. allowed: tension_crack, discard default: "tension_crack"
pore_pressure_pointsarrayoptionalDiscrete pore-pressure field as [[x, z, u], ...] triples (u in kPa) -- a flow-net / TIN sampling. When given, the base pore pressure at each slice is interpolated from this field (linear on the Delaunay triangulation, nearest-node fallback outside the hull, suction clamped to 0), OVERRIDING the gwt_points piezometric line and per-layer ru. The ponded-water buttress still comes from gwt_points, so set BOTH for a reservoir over a flow-net field.
nailsarrayoptionalSoil nails (per metre of slope run): [{x_head, z_head, length required; inclination deg below horizontal=15, bar_diameter mm=25, drill_hole_diameter mm=150, fy MPa=420, bond_stress kPa=100, spacing_h m=1.5, support_convention}]. Capacity = min(pullout behind slip surface, bar tensile)/spacing_h (FHWA GEC-7).
anchorsarrayoptionalTieback anchors: [{x_head, z_head, length, T_allow kN/m required; inclination=15, support_convention}]. Full T_allow applied when the bond zone crosses the slip surface.
geosyntheticsarrayoptionalHorizontal geosynthetic layers: [{elevation, T_allow kN/m required; x_start, x_end, support_convention optional}]. Every support (nails, anchors, geosynthetics, piles) acts at the base of the slice it crosses (Wright & Duncan 1991). support_convention: 'active' (default; Duncan & Wright Method A / Slide2 Active: the force is not divided by F and reduces the driving side -- give the ALLOWABLE force) or 'passive' (Method B / Slide2 Passive: divided by F with the soil strength -- give the ULTIMATE force; lower FOS for the same force). All methods.
stabilizing_pilesarrayoptionalSingle-row stabilizing/micro piles crossing the slope (Ito & Matsui 1975 or a specified shear): [{x required; spacing m=1.0 (D1); z_head, z_toe optional}]. Set the resistance EITHER by shear_capacity (kN per pile; per-metre force = shear_capacity/spacing) OR ito_matsui=true with diameter (m; D2=spacing-diameter) and optional c/phi/gamma (default: soil layer) giving the Ito-Matsui plastic lateral force integrated from head to slip surface. force_direction 'horizontal' (default) or 'normal'. support_convention 'active' (default) or 'passive' as for geosynthetics. Stabilizing force at the slip crossing.
reinforcement_forcefloatoptionalSingle equivalent horizontal reinforcement force (kN/m). Simpler alternative to nails/anchors. default: 0.0
reinforcement_elevationfloatoptionalElevation of the equivalent reinforcement force (m).
xcfloatoptionalCircle center x (m). Required for circular.
ycfloatoptionalCircle center y (m). Required for circular.
radiusfloatoptionalCircle radius (m). Required for circular.
slip_pointsarrayoptionalPolyline slip surface [[x,y],...] for noncircular. Use instead of xc/yc/radius.
variablesobjectrequiredRandom variables: {'phi': {cov: 0.1}, 'cu:Clay': {mean: 30, std: 5, dist: 'lognormal'}, ...}. Keys are layer parameters (phi, c_prime, cu, gamma, gamma_sat, ru) optionally scoped ':LayerName'; each spec needs cov or std (mean defaults to the layer value); dist is 'normal' (default) or 'lognormal'. Use gamma_sat (not dry gamma) for the unit weight of a submerged slope. A depth-varying undrained-strength law su(z)=a+b*(datum_z-z) is ONE correlated (a,b) variable applied coherently across layers — give an entry with a 'law':'linear_su' key: {'a':{mean,std|cov}, 'b':{mean,std|cov}, 'rho_ab':0..1, 'datum_z': elevation where su=a, 'z_ref':'mid'|'top'|'bottom', 'su_min': floor, 'layers': names|null}. A std-0 component (e.g. fixed intercept) drops out.
methodstroptionalLimit-equilibrium method for each FOS evaluation. allowed: fellenius, bishop, janbu, spencer, morgenstern_price, gle default: "bishop"
n_slicesintoptionalNumber of slices. default: 30
correlationsarrayoptionalOptional correlated scalar pairs: [['c_prime','phi',-0.5], ...] (or [{'var1','var2','rho'}]). Each references two SCALAR variable keys from 'variables' (optionally scoped ':LayerName') and a correlation rho in [-1,1]. FOSM adds the Taylor cross-term 2*rho*(dF1/2)*(dF2/2); Monte Carlo draws the pair from a bivariate normal. Omit for independent variables (default). A c'-phi' negative correlation typically lowers the FOS variance.
tolfloatoptionalConvergence tolerance for the iterative methods. default: 0.0001

monte_carlo_fos — Monte Carlo FOS distribution on a fixed slip surface (optionally re-searching the critical surface per realization): samples layer parameters (normal/lognormal), returns pf, FOS statistics and histogram.

10.1.14 fem2d — 2D finite-element analysis (fem2d)

fem2d_hs_parameters — Estimate HS/HSsmall model parameters for sand from relative density (Brinkgreve et al. 2010).

ParameterTypeDescription
relative_density_pctfloatrequiredRelative density Dr in PERCENT (10-100).

fem2d_gravity — Elastic gravity analysis of a rectangular soil column (plane strain FEM).

ParameterTypeDescription
widthfloatrequiredDomain width (m).
depthfloatrequiredDomain depth (m).
gammafloatrequiredUnit weight (kN/m3).
EfloatrequiredYoung's modulus (kPa).
nufloatrequiredPoisson's ratio.
nxintoptionalMesh divisions in x. default: 20
nyintoptionalMesh divisions in y. default: 10
tfloatoptionalOut-of-plane thickness of the plane-strain slice (m). Every result is per metre run and does not depend on it (the soil, walls, struts and joints all scale with it); leave it at 1. default: 1.0

fem2d_foundation — Elastic strip foundation analysis on a half-space (plane strain FEM).

ParameterTypeDescription
BfloatrequiredFoundation width (m).
qfloatrequiredApplied pressure (kPa, positive downward).
depthfloatrequiredDomain depth (m).
EfloatrequiredYoung's modulus (kPa).
nufloatrequiredPoisson's ratio.
gammafloatoptionalSoil unit weight (kN/m3). default: 0.0
nxintoptionalMesh divisions in x. default: 30
nyintoptionalMesh divisions in y. default: 15
tfloatoptionalOut-of-plane thickness of the plane-strain slice (m). Every result is per metre run and does not depend on it (the soil, walls, struts and joints all scale with it); leave it at 1. default: 1.0

fem2d_footing_capacity — Ultimate bearing capacity of a strip footing by FEM (plane-strain, the FE analogue of a bearing-capacity calc): footing='flexible' (default) ramps a uniform pressure to collapse, validated vs Prandtl Nc=5.14; footing='rigid' pushes the footing down as one body (GEC-6 p. 55: Eq. 5-7 assumes a rigid footing) and reads q from the reactions, but the Prandtl clay check read high and fell as the mesh was refined (348, 306 kPa on uniform 20x10, 40x20, 288, 273 on graded ones, vs 257), and for c-phi and c = 0 no mesh-converged value was found. On a frictional soil the flexible q_ult is a lower bound that a larger max_iter can raise (a warning says so). Use element_type='t6' (CST locks and never collapses).

ParameterTypeDescription
BfloatrequiredFooting width (m).
cfloatrequiredCohesion / undrained shear strength (kPa).
phifloatoptionalFriction angle (deg). Default 0 (Prandtl / undrained). default: 0.0
gammafloatoptionalSoil unit weight (kN/m3). Applied in full (with any surcharge) before the footing is loaded, so the footing acts on soil already stressed by its own weight. Default 0 = classical weightless mechanism (the validated basis). With c = 0 and no surcharge the uniform footing pressure fails at its edges at a load set by the mesh (halved when the elements are halved): not a bearing capacity. default: 0.0
EfloatoptionalYoung's modulus (kPa). default: 100000.0
nufloatoptionalPoisson's ratio. default: 0.3
psifloatoptionalDilation angle (deg). default: 0.0
surchargefloatoptionalUniform surcharge q beside the footing (kPa), e.g. an embedded footing's overburden gamma*Df (GEC-6 Eq. 5-1). Applied on the ground surface: with the soil's weight over the whole surface first, then held beside the footing while the footing pressure rises from q, so it resists through the Nq mechanism. q_ult is the gross pressure. default: 0.0
q_maxfloatoptionalTop of the load ramp (kPa). Default 1.6x the closed-form estimate c*Nc+surcharge*Nq+0.5*gamma*B*Ngamma. Pass explicitly for a c=phi=0 footing.
n_load_stepsintoptionalLoad increments; collapse-load resolution = (q_max - surcharge)/n_load_steps. Rigid: the number of equal settlement steps to settlement_max. default: 45
nxintoptionalMesh divisions in x. default: 40
nyintoptionalMesh divisions in y. default: 20
element_typestroptionalSoil element. t6 (recommended): collapse load within ~2% of Prandtl. cst LOCKS on the isochoric bearing mechanism and never collapses — do not use for capacity. allowed: t6, cst default: "t6"
q_appliedfloatoptionalWorking/design pressure (kPa). If given, bearing_FOS = q_ult/q_applied is reported.
footingstroptionalflexible (default): a uniform pressure ramped to collapse, the validated basis (Prandtl within ~2%). rigid: the footing's nodes pushed down together in n_load_steps settlement steps to settlement_max, q = their vertical reactions / B, q_ult the largest q reached. The default stays flexible on the mesh study (fem2d VALIDATION.md section 3): rigid reads high on these uniform meshes (Prandtl 348, 306 kPa on 20x10, 40x20 vs 257.1) and gives no plateau on a cohesionless soil. allowed: flexible, rigid default: "flexible"
basestroptionalRigid footing only. rough (default): footing nodes held horizontally, no slip (GEC-6 pp. 49-50: the wedge under the footing moves down with it; pp. 99-100: concrete cast on the ground takes tan delta = tan phi, on clay c_a = c_u). smooth: free to slide. allowed: rough, smooth default: "rough"
meshstroptionaluniform (default): evenly spaced grid lines. graded: the same nx x ny elements graded towards the footing's edges and the ground surface (the elements there 1/4 the uniform size; this module's choice), nx even. Mesh study (fem2d VALIDATION.md section 3, B = 2 m): graded brings the rigid footing nearer Prandtl's 257.1 (c = 50: 287.8, 273.1, 267.9, 265.3 kPa on 20x10 to 80x40, against 347.9 to 283.1 uniform) and the flexible one to 255.9 already on 20x10. graded is for undrained clay (phi = 0) only and is refused when phi > 0: on frictional soils it read far lower (c = 20, phi = 25, flexible: 151.9 against 455.6 kPa uniform on 40x20). Not the default. allowed: uniform, graded default: "uniform"
max_iterintoptionalIteration ceiling per load step. Default 1000 x max(1, nx*ny/800): 1000 on the default 40x20 mesh and coarser ones, more on finer ones (80x40: 4000), where the iteration converges more slowly (80x40 read 217.0 kPa at 1000 and 455.6, the 40x20 value, at 4000). On a frictional soil the flexible q_ult can rise with it (a warning says so).
settlement_maxfloatoptionalRigid footing only: the settlement the footing is pushed to (m). Default 10 q_est*B*(1-nu^2)/E, a settlement scale times 10, this module's choice (not printed in a reference), sized so q levelled off on the mesh study's cohesive cases; raise it when collapse_bracketed is False.
domain_depthfloatoptionalFE domain depth below the footing (m). Positive; default auto-sized.
domain_half_widthfloatoptionalFE domain half-width (m). Positive; default auto-sized.
tolfloatoptionalConvergence tolerance (residual norm). default: 0.0001

fem2d_slope_srm — Slope stability FOS via Strength Reduction Method (plane strain FEM).

ParameterTypeDescription
surface_pointsarrayrequiredGround surface as [[x,z],...] array.
soil_layersarrayrequiredArray of dicts with 'name','bottom_elevation','E','nu','c','phi','psi','gamma'.
depthfloatoptionalDepth below lowest surface (m). Default the larger of 2*H and 10 m.
nxintoptionalMesh divisions in x. default: 30
nyintoptionalMesh divisions in y. default: 15
x_extendfloatoptionalHorizontal margin (m): a number adds 30 % of it on each side, a [left, right] pair gives each side in metres. Default 0.3 max(0.5*H, depth, 5) each side; over undrained (phi = 0) soil below the toe the level ground is carried to twice that soil's depth each side, with nx raised to keep the element size (Taylor's deep circle; the result's notes say so). Pass 0 when the profile already has margins.
srf_tolfloatoptionalSRF bisection tolerance (0.01 for benchmark-grade runs). default: 0.02

srm_fieldstroptionalStrengths reduced by the SRF: both (default), cohesion only, or friction only. allowed: c_phi, c, phi default: "c_phi"
blowup_factorfloatoptionalSecondary failure criterion: dimensionless-displacement blowup threshold (x the value at the lowest stable SRF). null disables (pure Griffiths-Lane non-convergence). default: 15.0
srf_rangearrayoptional[min, max] SRF search range. default: [0.5, 3.0]
n_gpintoptionalT6 Gauss rule override (default 3). allowed: 3, 6
max_iterintoptionalIteration ceiling per load step (Griffiths-Lane non-convergence criterion). default: 1000
layer_polylinesdictoptional{layer_name: [[x,y],...]} bottom-boundary polylines for non-horizontal layering.
gamma_wfloatoptionalUnit weight of water (kN/m3). default: 9.81
n_load_stepsintoptionalNumber of load increments applied before the analysis / SRF sweep. default: 2
tfloatoptionalOut-of-plane thickness of the plane-strain slice (m). Every result is per metre run and does not depend on it (the soil, walls, struts and joints all scale with it); leave it at 1. default: 1.0
tolfloatoptionalConvergence tolerance (residual norm). default: 1e-05

fem2d_srm_mesh_refinement_study — Slope SRM factor of safety on a sequence of meshes (coarse to fine): per-mesh table, change between meshes, Richardson estimate, convergence flag. Runs fem2d_slope_srm once per mesh.

srf_tolfloatoptionalSRF bisection tolerance for every mesh. default: 0.02

max_iterintoptionalIteration ceiling per load step. default: 1000
layer_polylinesdictoptional{layer_name: [[x,y],...]} bottom-boundary polylines for non-horizontal layering.

n_load_stepsintoptionalNumber of load increments applied before the analysis / SRF sweep. default: 2
tfloatoptionalOut-of-plane thickness of the plane-strain slice (m). Every result is per metre run and does not depend on it (the soil, walls, struts and joints all scale with it); leave it at 1. default: 1.0
tolfloatoptionalConvergence tolerance (residual norm). default: 1e-05

fem2d_local_fos — Local (pointwise) factor-of-safety map for a slope: runs the SRM then evaluates local_FOS = Mohr-Coulomb available shear / mobilized shear at each element using the ORIGINAL strengths. At the critical SRF the minimum local FOS ~ the global SRM FOS and the low-FOS band is the failure mass. Returns summary stats (the full field is for plotting).

ParameterTypeDescription
surface_pointsarrayrequiredGround surface as [[x,z],...] array.
soil_layersarrayrequiredArray of dicts with 'name','bottom_elevation','E','nu','c','phi','psi','gamma' (same as fem2d_slope_srm).

nxintoptionalMesh divisions in x. default: 30
nyintoptionalMesh divisions in y. default: 15
x_extendfloatoptionalHorizontal margin (m). Pass 0 when the profile already has margins.
srf_tolfloatoptionalSRF bisection tolerance. default: 0.02
element_typestroptionalSoil element. t6 recommended (cst locks). allowed: t6, cst default: "t6"
srm_fieldstroptionalStrengths reduced by the SRF. allowed: c_phi, c, phi default: "c_phi"
n_gpintoptionalT6 Gauss rule override (default 3). allowed: 3, 6
max_iterintoptionalIteration ceiling per load step (Griffiths-Lane non-convergence criterion). default: 1000
local_fos_capfloatoptionalUpper cap on local FOS where the mobilized shear is ~0 (deep isotropic stress). default: 10.0
blowup_factorfloatoptionalDisplacement blow-up factor that flags SRM non-convergence. default: 15.0
gamma_wfloatoptionalUnit weight of water (kN/m3). default: 9.81

n_load_stepsintoptionalNumber of load increments applied before the analysis / SRF sweep. default: 2

fem2d_excavation — Staged excavation in front of an embedded wall (plane strain FEM): in-situ K0 stresses, then lifts with struts installed as the excavation reaches them; half of a symmetric excavation.

ParameterTypeDescription
widthfloatrequiredFull excavation width (m); the model is half of a symmetric excavation, its right boundary the centre line. For a one-sided cut give at least twice the passive zone in front of the wall.
depthfloatrequiredFinal excavation depth (m).
wall_depthfloatrequiredWall tip depth below the ground (m); must exceed depth.
soil_layersarrayrequiredArray of soil property dicts (E, nu, c, phi, psi, gamma = total unit weight, bottom_elevation; optional K0, else Jaky 1 - sin phi'; optional k = hydraulic conductivity m/s for the seepage of a dewatered excavation, every layer or none: a small k below the tip models a wall cut off into an impervious layer).
wall_EIfloatrequiredWall flexural stiffness (kN*m2/m).
wall_EAfloatrequiredWall axial stiffness (kN/m).
strutsarrayoptionalArray of {depth (m, above the final excavation level), stiffness (kN/m per m)}; each installed stress-free once the excavation reaches its level; no preload.
liftsarrayoptionalExcavation depths (m) at the end of each lift; default one lift to each strut level, then to depth.
wall_contactstroptional'smooth' (default): no wall friction (Rankine). 'bonded': the wall shares the soil's nodes and hangs the retained soil (thrust below active). 'interface': wall friction delta between 0 and phi' (Mohr-Coulomb joints between wall and soil); give interface_delta or interface_ratio. allowed: smooth, bonded, interface default: "smooth"
interface_deltafloatoptionalFor wall_contact='interface': the wall friction angle delta (deg, 0-45), the same on every layer. UFC 3-220-20 (2025) Table 4-1, p. 184: steel sheet piles against clean sand 17, clean gravel 22, silty sand 14; formed concrete against clean sand 17-22. Give this or interface_ratio.
interface_ratiofloatoptionalFor wall_contact='interface', in place of interface_delta: delta/phi' (0-1) of the layer at each joint.
interface_adhesionfloatoptionalFor wall_contact='interface': adhesion c_a (kPa) on the wall (UFC 3-220-20 Table 4-1 gives it for clayey soils by undrained strength). Default 0 (friction only). default: 0.0
gwtfloat|arrayoptionalGroundwater table elevation (m, the ground is 0, negative below it): the in-situ table, held outside the excavation. What happens inside where it is above the excavation level is excavation_water.
excavation_waterstroptionalWater inside the excavation where the table is above the excavation level. 'dewatered' (default, the construction case: UFC 3-220-20 p. 97, groundwater control below the table; Caltrans T&S Example 7-2): lowered to the excavation level at each lift, steady seepage under the wall's tip, the wall carries the net water pressure (GEC 4 sec. 5.2.9). 'full': kept full of water to the table (dug in the wet; the water on the two faces balances). 'level': lowered to water_level_inside. allowed: dewatered, full, level default: "dewatered"
water_level_insidefloatoptionalFor excavation_water='level': depth (m below the ground) of the water inside the excavation, between the table and the excavation depth.
n_stepsintoptionalLoad steps in each stage. default: 10
max_iterintoptionalIteration ceiling per load step. default: 1000
layer_polylinesdictoptional{layer_name: [[x,y],...]} bottom-boundary polylines for non-horizontal layering.
gamma_wfloatoptionalUnit weight of water (kN/m3). default: 9.81
nxintoptionalMesh divisions in x (horizontal). default: 30
nyintoptionalMesh divisions in y (vertical). default: 15
tfloatoptionalOut-of-plane thickness of the plane-strain slice (m). Every result is per metre run and does not depend on it (the soil, walls, struts and joints all scale with it); leave it at 1. default: 1.0
tolfloatoptionalConvergence tolerance (residual norm). default: 1e-05

fem2d_seepage — Steady-state seepage analysis (Laplace equation, CST elements).

ParameterTypeDescription
nodesarrayrequiredNode coordinates [[x,y],...].
elementsarrayrequiredCST connectivity [[n1,n2,n3],...].
kfloat|arrayrequiredHydraulic conductivity (m/s). Scalar or per-element.
head_bcsarrayrequiredDirichlet BCs [[node_id, head_value],...].
gamma_wfloatoptionalUnit weight of water (kN/m3). default: 9.81
tfloatoptionalOut-of-plane thickness of the plane-strain slice (m). No result depends on it: the heads and pore pressures do not, and the flow is reported per metre run. Leave it at 1. default: 1.0

fem2d_consolidation — Coupled Biot consolidation analysis (settlement + pore pressure dissipation).

ParameterTypeDescription
widthfloatrequiredDomain width (m).
depthfloatrequiredDomain depth (m).
soil_layersarrayrequiredSoil property dicts, each with 'E' (kPa), 'nu', 'gamma' (kN/m3) AND 'bottom_elevation' (m; 'top_elevation' optional, defaults to the domain top / the layer above). Add 'fill': true to a layer PLACED during construction: its self-weight then moves from the initial stage into the load stage (monolithic: applied undrained with the load, so it consolidates). Fill layers must be the top layers; they may be placed under water (gwt above their base): below gwt a fill loads the soil by its buoyant unit weight gamma - gamma_w, the water standing on the soil in place before placement being part of the initial stage.
kfloatrequiredHydraulic conductivity (m/s) for 'staggered'; for 'monolithic' pass the MOBILITY m^2/(kPa.s).
load_qfloatrequiredSurface load (kPa, positive downward).
time_pointsarrayrequiredOUTPUT times since the load is applied (seconds, >= 0). t = 0 (the loading instant) is always reported first; U and settlement come back at each of these times. The monolithic scheme integrates on a finer internal schedule between them, so a sparse list (e.g. [1e3, 1e6, 1e7]) is fine.
gwtfloatoptionalGWT elevation (m). default: 0.0
n_wfloatoptionalFor 'monolithic': the Biot modulus M (kPa) (~2.2e6 for near-incompressible water). Governs the undrained load response p0. Ignored by 'staggered'. default: 2200000.0
nxintoptionalMesh divisions in x (horizontal). default: 10
nyintoptionalMesh divisions in y (vertical). default: 20
tfloatoptionalOut-of-plane thickness of the plane-strain slice (m). Every result is per metre run and does not depend on it (the soil, walls, struts and joints all scale with it); leave it at 1. default: 1.0
gamma_wfloatoptionalUnit weight of water (kN/m3). default: 9.81
layer_polylinesarrayoptionalOptional explicit layer-boundary polylines [[[x,z],...],...] for non-horizontal layering.
consolidation_schemestringoptionalBiot solver: 'staggered' (default, sequential split; drained at every step, so U = 1 and NO consolidation transient under the load) or 'monolithic' (coupled u-p, Taylor-Hood T6/T3, reproduces the load-induced undrained response p0 and the Terzaghi transient; use it for U and settlement versus time). For 'monolithic', pass k as the MOBILITY m^2/(kPa.s) and n_w as the Biot modulus M (kPa). allowed: staggered, monolithic default: "staggered"
thetafloatoptionalTime-integration parameter for the monolithic scheme (1.0 backward Euler; 0.5 Crank-Nicolson, more accurate). Range [0.5, 1.0]. default: 1.0
startup_stepsintoptionalMonolithic scheme with theta < 1: the first startup_steps time steps are each taken as two fully implicit half-steps (Rannacher start-up), so Crank-Nicolson does not ring at the drained boundary. 0 = plain theta-stepping from the first step. default: 2
reset_displacements_afterstringoptionalWhich stage the reported settlements are measured from. The analysis has two stages: 0 'initial' (self-weight of the soil in place, drained, with the hydrostatic water table and any ponded water) and 1 'load' (load_q + any 'fill' layers, then consolidation). 'initial' = from the end of the initial stage, i.e. the load stage alone (common FE practice; the DEFAULT when omitted). 'start' = cumulative, self-weight settlement included. Omitting it lets the default apply and the result then carries a 'judgment' record if the choice matters. allowed: initial, start also read as: first = initial, 0 = initial, none = start

fem2d_staged — Staged construction analysis (multi-phase, activate/deactivate soil groups and beams); reports each stage's own movement, the cumulative movement and the movement since a reference stage.

ParameterTypeDescription
nodesarrayrequiredNode coordinates [[x,y],...].
elementsarrayrequiredElement connectivity [[n1,n2,n3],...].
material_propsarrayrequiredPer-element material dicts.
gammafloat|arrayrequiredUnit weight. Scalar or per-element.
element_groupsdictrequiredGroup name -> list of element indices.
phasesarrayrequiredArray of phase dicts: name, active_soil_groups, active_beam_ids, surface_loads [[edges, qx, qy]], gwt, n_steps, reset_displacements (true = report this phase's movements from its START, PLAXIS 'reset displacements to zero'; reporting only). Phase 0 is normally the initial (gravity) stage; soil PLACED during construction (fill) is a group first activated in a later phase, so its self-weight movement falls in that phase.
beam_elementsarrayoptionalArray of beam element dicts.
reset_displacements_afterint|stringoptionalThe stage at whose END displacement_since_reference is zeroed: a stage index, a stage name, 'initial' (= stage 0) or 'start' (no reset: cumulative). DEFAULT when omitted (and no phase sets reset_displacements): after stage 0, taken as the initial gravity/K0 stage, so construction movements exclude self-weight (common FE practice); the result then carries a 'judgment' record if the choice matters.
gamma_wfloatoptionalUnit weight of water (kN/m3). default: 9.81
max_iterintoptionalMax Newton-Raphson iterations per load step (raise for a hard-to-converge model). default: 500
tfloatoptionalOut-of-plane thickness of the plane-strain slice (m). Every result is per metre run and does not depend on it (the soil, walls, struts and joints all scale with it); leave it at 1. default: 1.0
tolfloatoptionalConvergence tolerance (residual norm). default: 1e-05

10.1.15 seismic_geotech — Seismic geotechnics

gmax — Small-strain shear modulus Gmax from Vs, CPT, void ratio, or PI/OCR.

ParameterTypeDescription
correlationstrrequiredvs: G=rho*Vs^2 (GEC-5 Eq. 8.1); cpt_sand: Rix & Stokoe (1991), quartz sand, GEC-5 Table 8-7; cpt_clay: Mayne & Rix (1993), clay, Gmax = 49.4 qt^0.695 e^-1.130 (MPa), GEC-5 Table 8-7, needs void_ratio; hardin_black: Hardin (1978) for fine-grained soils, GEC-5 Eq. 8.14 (A F(e) OCR^k pa^0.5 sigma_m'^0.5, F(e) = 1/(0.3 + 0.7 e^2)); andersen: Andersen (2015) clay from PI/OCR (not in the print held). allowed: vs, cpt_sand, cpt_clay, hardin_black, andersen

sigma_m_efffloatoptionalMean effective stress (kPa) — for 'hardin_black'.

OCRfloatoptionalOverconsolidation ratio — for 'andersen' and 'hardin_black' (not given there: 1).

modulus_reduction — Ishibashi & Zhang (1993) G/Gmax and damping vs cyclic strain.

seismic_earth_pressure — Mononobe-Okabe active/passive seismic earth pressure coefficients.

ParameterTypeDescription
phifloatrequiredFriction angle (degrees).
khfloatrequiredHorizontal seismic coefficient.
kvfloatoptionalVertical seismic coefficient (positive upward). Enters KAE through the seismic angle psi = atan(kh/(1-kv)) (UFC 3-220-20 Eq. 4-15) and, with gamma and H, the thrust PAE = (gamma H^2/2)(1-kv) KAE (Eq. 4-16). default: 0.0
deltafloatoptionalWall friction angle (deg). Defaults to 2/3 phi.
betafloatoptionalWall back face batter from vertical (degrees), positive when the back face leans toward the backfill (lowers KAE). UFC 3-220-20 Eq. 4-15 and Fig. 4-8 measure their theta the other way: theta = -beta. default: 0.0
ifloatoptionalBackfill slope angle (degrees); UFC 3-220-20 Eq. 4-15's beta. default: 0.0
include_passivebooloptionalAlso return KPE (passive seismic coefficient, GEC-4 Eq. 44). default: false
delta_passivefloatoptionalWall friction angle behind KPE (deg). Not given: 0.4 phi, the most UFC 3-220-20 Fig. 4-8 (p. 187) allows a planar (Coulomb) passive wedge ("unconservative for delta/phi' > 0.4"); FHWA NHI-06-089 p. 10-19 finds a planar passive wedge unreliable above phi'/3 and recommends log-spiral charts, with which its p. 10-17 maximum of phi/2 goes. Above 0.4 phi the result warns.
gammafloatoptionalSoil unit weight (kN/m3) for force calculation.
HfloatoptionalWall height (m) for force calculation.
KAfloatoptionalStatic active coefficient behind PA and delta-PAE. Not given: Rankine Ka from phi (vertical wall, level backfill, no wall friction).

10.1.16 liquefaction — Liquefaction (unified tool)

liquefaction_analysis — Unified liquefaction triggering. Auto-routes by input type: CPT (q_c/f_s) -> Boulanger & Idriss 2014 (liquepy, with LPI/LSN/LDI and a depth_profile of FS and post-liquefaction volumetric strain); SPT (N160) -> B&I-2014 by default, or NCEER/Youd-2001 via method='nceer2001' for code-compliance work. For post-liquefaction downdrag on a pile, give this result to downdrag.post_liquefaction_downdrag as liquefaction_result.

cpt_liquefaction — CPT-based liquefaction triggering analysis (Boulanger & Idriss 2014) with LPI, LSN, LDI.

pm4sand_cyclic_dss — PM4Sand undrained cyclic DSS analysis for liquefaction triggering.

ParameterTypeDescription

ru_thresholdfloatoptionalPore pressure ratio threshold for liquefaction. default: 0.95
phi_cvfloatoptionalCritical-state friction angle (degrees). default: 33.0
h0floatoptionalPM4Sand h0, plastic-to-elastic modulus ratio (-1 = model default). default: -1.0
e_maxfloatoptionalMaximum void ratio. default: 0.8
e_minfloatoptionalMinimum void ratio. default: 0.5
nbfloatoptionalBounding surface parameter. default: 0.5
ndfloatoptionalDilatancy surface parameter. default: 0.1
AdofloatoptionalDilatancy parameter (-1 = model default). default: -1.0
z_maxfloatoptionalMaximum fabric-dilatancy tensor (-1 = model default). default: -1.0
c_zfloatoptionalFabric growth parameter. default: 250.0

nufloatoptionalPoisson's ratio (omit for the model default).
g_degrfloatoptionalElastic modulus degradation with fabric. default: 2.0
c_drfloatoptionalRotated dilatancy surface parameter (-1 = model default). default: -1.0

QfloatoptionalCritical state line parameter Q. default: 10.0

site_response_1d — 1D effective-stress site response analysis (PDMY02/PIMY + Lysmer dashpot).

ParameterTypeDescription
layersarrayrequiredSoil layers (required): list of dicts, each with thickness (m), Vs (m/s), density (Mg/m3) and material_type: 'sand' needs phi (degrees; optional K0 (default Jaky 1 - sin phi; it sets only the reference pressure where G = density Vs^2, while the column's own horizontal stress after gravity follows nu), PTAng and the PressureDependMultiYield02 constants contrac1, contrac2, contrac3, dilat1, dilat2, dilat3, liquefac1, liquefac2, default the OpenSees wiki's Dr = 40 % column), 'clay' needs su (kPa, undrained strength in simple shear). Optional for any layer: n_elem (its element count, default n_elem_per_layer; a layer the water table falls inside is meshed in two parts with a node at the water table), nu (Poisson's ratio, default 0.3 sand, 0.495 clay), permeability (hydraulic conductivity k, m/s, default 1e-4 sand, 1e-7 clay), stabilization_alpha (the u-p element's pressure stabilization, default h^2 / (4 (K + 4/3 G)) per element, the element documentation's formula), e_init (void ratio, default 0.77 sand, 0.85 clay), n_surf (yield surfaces, default 20; not with a fitted curve), and curve, the modulus-reduction curve the material's backbone follows to the layer's strength: 'opensees' (default, the material's own hyperbolic backbone, much stiffer than laboratory curves in sand), 'darendeli' (Darendeli 2001; optional plas_index 0, ocr 1, freq_hz 1, n_cycles 10), 'menq' (Menq 2003; needs uniformity_coeff Cu and diam_mean D50 in mm) or 'user' (needs G_Gmax_curve {strain_pct: [...], G_Gmax: [...]}; optional damping_curve {strain_pct: [...], damping_pct: [...]}, reported, not imposed).
motionstroptionalBuilt-in motion name (e.g. 'synthetic_pulse'), taken as a rock outcrop motion. Give motion (a built-in name) OR accel_history + dt: one of the two is required.
accel_historyarrayoptionalCustom acceleration time history (g). Give motion (a built-in name) OR accel_history + dt: one of the two is required.
dtfloatoptionalTime step for custom motion (s).
target_pga_gfloatoptionalScale the input motion linearly so its PGA equals this value (g) before the analysis (the built-in motions have fixed PGAs: synthetic_pulse 0.30 g, synthetic_long 0.15 g). Applied before scale_factor; give one or the other.
gwt_depthfloatoptionalGroundwater table depth (m). default: 0.0
bedrock_VsfloatoptionalBedrock shear wave velocity (m/s). default: 760.0
bedrock_densityfloatoptionalBedrock mass density (Mg/m3). default: 2.4
dampingfloatoptionalTarget Rayleigh damping ratio. default: 0.02
scale_factorfloatoptionalScale factor for input acceleration. default: 1.0
n_elem_per_layerintoptionalElements per soil layer (a layer's own n_elem overrides it). default: 4
rayleigh_freqs_hzarrayoptionalThe two frequencies [f1, f2] (Hz) at which the Rayleigh damping equals damping.
pga_lowpass_hzfloatoptionalCorner (Hz) of the low-pass (fourth-order Butterworth, run forward and backward) behind pga_surface_lowpass_g and pga_input_lowpass_g, and of the test of whether motion above it sets the raw PGA; the tool's choice, no reference prints one. pga_surface_g is never filtered. default: 10.0
linear_elasticbooloptionalKeep the soil linear elastic through the shaking (Gmax = rho*Vs^2, Rayleigh damping only): a check of the column, not a design analysis. default: false

10.1.19 pystrata — Equivalent-linear site response (pyStrata)

eql_site_response — 1D equivalent-linear site response analysis (SHAKE-type, Darendeli/Menq/custom curves).

ParameterTypeDescription
layersarrayrequiredSoil layers from surface to bedrock (required). Each dict: thickness (m; the LAST layer is the bedrock half-space, thickness 0), Vs (m/s), unit_wt (kN/m3) and soil_model, plus that model's own keys: 'darendeli' needs plas_index (PI, %; optional ocr, default 1, and stress_mean, kPa, default from depth); 'menq' optional uniformity_coeff (default 10), diam_mean (mm, default 5), stress_mean; 'linear' needs damping (ratio 0-1, e.g. 0.02); 'custom' needs strains, mod_reduc and damping_values (equal-length lists). At least 2 layers (1 soil + bedrock).
motionstroptionalBuilt-in motion name (e.g. 'synthetic_pulse'). Give motion OR accel_history + dt.
accel_historyarrayoptionalCustom acceleration time history (g); with dt, instead of motion.
dtfloatoptionalTime step of accel_history (s); required with it.
target_pga_gfloatoptionalScale the input motion linearly so its PGA equals this value (g) before the analysis (the built-in motions have fixed PGAs: synthetic_pulse 0.30 g, synthetic_long 0.15 g). Frequency content and duration are kept.
strain_ratiofloatoptionalEffective-to-max shear strain ratio (0.5-1.0). default: 0.65
tolerancefloatoptionalConvergence tolerance as a fraction: stop when no layer's shear modulus or damping changes by more than this between iterations (0.01 = 1 %). default: 0.01
max_iterationsintoptionalMaximum EQL iterations. default: 15
max_freq_hzfloatoptionalMax frequency for auto-discretization (Hz). default: 25.0
wave_fracfloatoptionalWavelength fraction for auto-discretization. default: 0.2

ParameterTypeDescription

At least 2 layers (1 soil + bedrock).

10.1.20 seismic_signals — Ground-motion signal processing

response_spectrum — Compute the response spectrum, every period by Nigam and Jennings (1969): the record linear between samples, in sub-steps of at most a twentieth of the period, the peak read between samples (the OpenSees site response uses the same code).

ParameterTypeDescription
motionstroptionalBuilt-in motion name (e.g. 'synthetic_pulse'). Give motion (a built-in name) OR accel_history + dt: one of the two is required.
accel_historyarrayoptionalCustom acceleration time history (g). Give motion (a built-in name) OR accel_history + dt: one of the two is required.
dtfloatoptionalTime step for custom motion (s).
target_pga_gfloatoptionalScale the motion linearly so its PGA equals this value (g) before the analysis (the built-in motions have fixed PGAs: synthetic_pulse 0.30 g, synthetic_long 0.15 g). Frequency content and duration are kept.
periodsarrayoptionalSpectral periods (s). Default: logspace(-2, 1, 200).
dampingfloatoptionalDamping ratio (decimal). default: 0.05

intensity_measures — Compute earthquake intensity measures (Arias intensity, CAV, significant duration).

ParameterTypeDescription
motionstroptionalBuilt-in motion name. Give motion (a built-in name) OR accel_history + dt: one of the two is required.
accel_historyarrayoptionalCustom acceleration time history (g). Give motion (a built-in name) OR accel_history + dt: one of the two is required.
dtfloatoptionalTime step for custom motion (s).
target_pga_gfloatoptionalScale the motion linearly so its PGA equals this value (g) before the analysis (the built-in motions have fixed PGAs: synthetic_pulse 0.30 g, synthetic_long 0.15 g). Frequency content and duration are kept.
sig_dur_startfloatoptionalHusid start fraction for significant duration. default: 0.05
sig_dur_endfloatoptionalHusid end fraction for significant duration. default: 0.95

rotd_spectrum — Compute rotated spectral acceleration (RotD0/RotD50/RotD100 or any percentile) from two horizontal components (Boore 2010): each component's oscillator response by Nigam and Jennings (1969), the record linear between samples, rotated through 0-179 deg, the peak at each angle read between samples. RotD100 of a component paired with zeros is that component's response_spectrum.

ParameterTypeDescription
motion_astroptionalBuilt-in motion name for component A. Give motion_a (a built-in name) OR accel_history_a + dt: one of the two is required.
accel_history_aarrayoptionalCustom acceleration for component A (g). Give motion_a (a built-in name) OR accel_history_a + dt: one of the two is required.

accel_history_barrayoptionalCustom acceleration for component B (g). Give motion_b (a built-in name) OR accel_history_b + dt: one of the two is required.
dtfloatoptionalTime step (s). Required for custom motions.
periodsarrayoptionalSpectral periods (s). Default: logspace(-2, 1, 200).
dampingfloatoptionalDamping ratio (decimal). default: 0.05
percentilesarrayoptionalPercentiles to compute (0-100). Default: [0, 50, 100].

signal_processing — Bandpass filtering and/or baseline correction of acceleration time history.

ParameterTypeDescription
motionstroptionalBuilt-in motion name. Give motion (a built-in name) OR accel_history + dt: one of the two is required.

spt_correction — Raw field SPT N -> N60 -> (N1)60: N60 = N ER/60 (NHI-06-088 Eq 3-2), then the overburden correction C_N (Liao & Whitman by default; Peck et al. 1974, AASHTO's; or EN ISO 22476-3).

ParameterTypeDescription
N_fieldfloatrequiredRaw field SPT blow count.
sigma_vo_efffloatrequiredVertical effective stress at test depth (kPa).
energy_ratio_pctfloatoptionalHammer energy ratio ER (%). NHI-06-088 p. 3-55: about 35-85 for cathead systems (donut or safety hammer), about 60 on average; 80-100 for automatic trip hammers; unmeasured, AASHTO takes 60 for rope and cathead and 80 for automatic. default: 60.0
rod_length_mfloatoptionalRod length (m); sets CR band (0.75 below 3 m up to 1.0 beyond 10 m; Youd et al. 2001 Table 2). default: 10.0
borehole_diameter_mmfloatoptionalBorehole diameter (mm); CB = 1.0/1.05/1.15 (Youd et al. 2001 Table 2). default: 100.0
sampler_correctionfloatoptionalCS: 1.0 standard sampler, 1.1-1.3 without liners (Youd et al. 2001 Table 2). default: 1.0
